author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕರಣವಹು ನಿನದೇಹ ಕಾರಣವ ಪೂರೈಸೆ
ಪರಿಕಿಸುವ ಜಗನಿನ್ನ ಜಡತೆಗಳನೊಡ್ಡಿ
ಪರಿವಿಡಿಯ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿ ಪರಿಣತಿಯ ಹೊಂದುತಿರೆ
ಧರಣಿಯನೆ ಆಳುವೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Your body is the instrument for fulfilling a purpose;
the world tests you by putting inertia before you;
if you correct the order of things and keep gaining skill,
you will rule the earth, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The body is a tool for a purpose. The world tests us with inertia and obstacles. Put things in order and keep improving, and you will master your world.
